name: Agrippina (Handel)
description: Handel opera in the baroque palace theatre of Schwetzingen
hours: 19:30 (Sun 13 Dec 15:00, Sun 24 Jan 18:00); intro 30 min before
details:
Handel's "Agrippina" (dramma per musica, libretto by Vincenzo Grimani) in a new production of Theater und Orchester Heidelberg for its "Winter in Schwetzingen" baroque festival. Conductor Gerd Amelung, director Claudia Isabel Martin, Philharmonisches Orchester Heidelberg.

Played in the small rococo theatre of Schwetzingen Palace (1752), one of the oldest working court theatres. Sung in Italian with German surtitles; age 14+. Introduction 30 minutes before each show. The page lists no prices; box office +49 6221 5820 000.
